coordinate_system: ELF virtual address; FDE ends exclusive

symbolic_complete_low.assumptions: named mode and successful writes; both time words zero; date word in time_example; prior prefix inputs; next_oid, next_lid, next_twap_id, system_nonce, use_system_nonce and mac are zero

symbolic_prefix.assumptions: named mode, successful writes; initial_height=0, version=1, hardfork.round=2, height=3, tx_index tag != 1, round=4

symbolic_present_low.assumptions: same as symbolic_complete_low except tx_index tag=1 with value=5 and use_system_nonce=1
